newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: SOCCER-SUNDERLAND'S QUINN RECALLED TO IRELAND SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SUNDERLAND'S QUINN RECALLED TO IRELAND SQUAD.

text.p: Sunderland striker Niall Quinn was recalled to Ireland's 22-man squad on Friday for their World Cup group eight qualifier against Liechtenstein at Lansdowne Road on May 21.
Quinn, 30, won the last of his 61 caps when Ireland beat Liechtenstein 5-0 in Vaduz last August.
He missed Ireland's last five internationals and five months of the English premier league season with a damaged cruciate ligament.
Goalkeepers: Alan Kelly (Sheffield United), Shay Given (Blackburn Rovers).

Defenders: Denis Irwin (Manchester United), Ken Cunningham (Wimbledon), Gary Breen (Coventry City), Ian Harte (Leeds United), Curtis Fleming (Middlesbrough), Jeff Kenna (Blackburn Rovers), Terry Phelan (Everton).

Midfielders: Gary Kelly (Leeds United), Steve Staunton (Aston Villa), Ray Houghton (Crystal Palace), Roy Keane (Manchester United), Andy Townsend (Aston Villa), Alan McLoughlin (Portsmouth), Gareth Farrelly (Aston Villa).
Strikers: Niall Quinn (Sunderland), Tony Cascarino (Nancy), Jon Goodman (Wimbledon), David Connolly (Watford), David Kelly (Sunderland), Mark Kennedy (Liverpool).
